intro.lore: In 4E 210, nearly a decade after the Dragon Crisis, Skyrim stands transformed. To combat the Aldmeri Dominion, former enemies united alongside Hammerfell to sign The Treaty of The Nine Holds, successfully expelling the Thalmor in the brutal Second Great War. Today, the victorious but scarred province is split into three political zones: the Western Imperial Legion, the Eastern Stormcloaks, and the neutral central hub of Whiterun. As this new era begins, Skyrim's ultimate fate remains undecided.

The button then reads Update Modlist (manifest from MO2, test server load order, Data folder and database), then Update Version, which publishes the test client version. migrate.title: Migrate
migrate.help: Only way to the Main Server, which must be stopped. Migrate server copies dist_back, scam_native.node, gamemode and the server data files (never the world, settings or player state); it then reads Migrate settings, which merges new test settings into the live server-settings.json without touching its name, ports, players, database, access or Discord keys. Migrate client installs the test manifest, modlist and extras live, syncs the live load order, Data folder and database and mirrors build/dist/testclient onto build/dist/client. Old files go to build/dist/backup. The Live and Test rows publish the server and client versions of that side in versions.json (Save writes the filled fields only); Copy test build fills both from the skymp5-server and skymp5-client packages. Versions may carry a build, e.g. 1.2.3-b4 or 1.2.3+4.

launcher.title: Launcher
launcher.help: Version Save sets the version of the next build only. Downloads then come from the website, not this server.

maxPlayers.label: Max connections
maxPlayers.help: RakNet connection cap including the queue room, at most the native MAX_PLAYERS (1300). To test the queue lower Play slots, never this: a connection above this number is refused before the queue sees it.

playerSlots.help: Verified logins that may play at once; logins above it wait in the queue up to Max connections. Empty = Max connections (queue off). Read at boot.

queueGraceMs.label: Queue grace (ms)
queueGraceMs.help: How long a disconnected player keeps their slot or queue place. Default 120000.

queueStaffBypass.label: Staff skip the queue
queueStaffBypass.help: On (default, also when unset): adminRoles tiers, adminRoleIds and adminProfileIds never wait. Turn off to test the queue with a staff account. Read at boot.

uiListenHost.label: UI listen host
uiListenHost.help: Bind address for the HTTP/UI port.

offlineMode.label: Offline mode
offlineMode.help: When on, any profile id may connect; master/masterKey are ignored.

master.label: Master URL
master.help: Master API URL for online-mode session validation. Empty = offline.

masterKey.label: Master key
masterKey.help: Public server id, not a secret: players receive it via /api/serverinfo and the launcher. The backend reads it from here.

masterApiAuthToken.label: Master API auth token
masterApiAuthToken.help: Private secret sent as X-Auth-Token on heartbeats, bans and purchases. The backend reads it from here.

enableConsoleCommandsForAll.label: Console commands for all (keep off)
enableConsoleCommandsForAll.help: Must stay off. The console is disabled on this server; turning this on skips the admin check and gives every player additem, placeatme and the other server console commands.

characterSelect.label: Character select
characterSelect.help: Show the character-select screen on join.

characterSelectMaxCharacters.label: Max characters
characterSelectMaxCharacters.help: Character slots per player when character select is on (1-10, default 3).

npcCorpseWatch.label: NPC corpse watch (debug)
npcCorpseWatch.help: On: every 2 s the spawn-zone poll reads each zone corpse's position and navmesh height and logs a body that jumped 64+ units or lies 32+ units under the navmesh (evidence for corpse sync reports). Off (default, also when unset): no corpse is read; keep it off on live. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

masteryResetsPerCharacter.label: Profession resets per character
masteryResetsPerCharacter.help: How many times a player may set a craft aside from the profession menu on one character; the hours go with it. With multiclassing one count is shared by all slots and a reset clears one slot. Read at boot. Default 1.

masteryHourBank.label: Profession hour bank
masteryHourBank.help: Hours that extra crafts inside the counted hour may bank, shared by every craft slot of a character and paid in craft order, one per hour after the last counted hour. The Skills tab strip has one cell more than this (2 is hours 1, 2 and 3). 0 turns the bank off. Read at boot. Default 2.

masteryBankOffline.label: Hour bank counts offline
masteryBankOffline.help: On (default): a banked hour falls due an hour after the last counted hour whether the character is online or not, and what fell due while away is paid at login. Off: it needs a full hour of online time, time logged out does not count. The Skills tab shows the rule in force. Read at boot.

masterySlots.label: Craft slots (multiclassing)
masterySlots.help: Profession slots in pick order, 1 to 3: [{ name, cap, rankHours }]. cap is a rank name or index from Novice to Legendary; rankHours the hours for each rank from Novice (the primary defaults to 0 plus masteryRankHours). Empty or one entry (the default [{ "name": "Primary", "cap": "Legendary" }]) is multiclassing off, records kept. Test: Secondary to Adept at [20, 60], Tertiary to Novice at [20]. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

masterySlotKits.label: Sub-slot kits
masterySlotKits.help: On (default): a secondary or tertiary pick hands over that craft's kit items (masteryKits), never gold, once per craft per character, none when the primary kit was that craft's. Read at boot.

securityAlertChannelId.label: Security alert channel
securityAlertChannelId.help: Discord channel id where the backend posts every new Security tab alert (ban evasion, gold spawning). Read live. Empty posts nothing.

needsFatigueEnabled.label: Fatigue enabled
needsFatigueEnabled.help: Off makes every craft, gather, kill and cast cost no fatigue; hunger keeps running. Read at boot. Default on.

needsFatigueOfflinePerHour.label: Fatigue refill per offline hour
needsFatigueOfflinePerHour.help: Share of the fatigue bar refilled per hour logged out, added at login and capped at a full bar. 1 = 100% an hour, the online rate; 0 turns it off. Read at boot. Default 1.

torchBurnMinutes.label: Torch burn (minutes)
torchBurnMinutes.help: Minutes of use after which a held torch burns out and one is taken from the inventory; the burn carries over relogs. 0 turns it off. Read at boot. Default 15.

goldAlertThreshold.label: Gold alert threshold
goldAlertThreshold.help: Gold a character may gain between two samples, 10 to 60 seconds apart, before the Security tab gets a Gold Spawning alert. 0 disables it. Read at boot. Default 5000.

manaclesFormId.label: Manacles item
manaclesFormId.help: Form id (number or "0x..." string) of the item a captor must hold to restrain a player. Defaults to vanilla prisoner cuffs 0x0005DC02.

captiveAnimEvent.label: Captive anim event
captiveAnimEvent.help: Behaviour-graph event played on a restrained player. Leave empty for the default bound-hands pose.

carrierAnimEvent.label: Carrier anim event
carrierAnimEvent.help: Behaviour-graph event played on a player carrying someone. Leave empty for the default hold pose.

startingItems.label: Starting items
startingItems.help: Kit granted to fresh characters: [{ baseId, count }]. baseId as a number or "0x..." string. Default: the miner clothes; the gold comes with the first profession kit (masteryKitGold). Gold (0x0000000f) listed here is granted once per slot, and that character's profession kit then comes without gold. Wearable kit items are equipped when character creation finishes.

playersInheritBaseSpells.label: Players inherit base spells
playersInheritBaseSpells.help: On (default): player characters carry the Player record's castable spells (Flames, Healing) and their race's greater power. Off: characters start without them; abilities, racial passives, lesser powers (Night Eye) and spells learned from tomes stay. Read by the native server at boot.

logoutGraceMs.label: Logout grace (ms)
logoutGraceMs.help: How long a disconnected body stays killable in the world before despawning. Default 300000.

respawnSeconds.label: Respawn seconds
respawnSeconds.help: Bleedout/respawn timer applied to players (gamemode). Default 15.

afkKickMinutes.label: AFK kick (minutes)
afkKickMinutes.help: Minutes without movement, chat, or voice before an idle player is kicked. Players still in character creation are never kicked. 0 disables. Default 20.

afkWarnMinutes.label: AFK warning (minutes)
afkWarnMinutes.help: Minutes before the AFK kick to warn the player in chat. Default 1.

regenerationMultiplier.label: Regen multiplier
regenerationMultiplier.help: Scales the health/magicka/stamina regen the server accepts from clients. 1 = race-record rates, 0 = no natural regen. Needs a native rebuild to change engine behavior; the setting itself is read at boot.

healthRegenerationMultiplier.label: Health regen multiplier
healthRegenerationMultiplier.help: Takes the place of Regen multiplier for health only; magicka and stamina keep it. 0.08 matches the Slow health regeneration ability of plugin r29 (a full bar in about 30 minutes); 0 refuses all regeneration, every health increase a client reports (potions, food and Restoration still heal). Empty (default) = health follows Regen multiplier. Protected: Migrate settings never carries it to live. Needs a native server build from ea63f69a or later. Read at boot.

npcBlockedDamageShare.label: NPC blocked damage share
npcBlockedDamageShare.help: Share of an NPC's weapon hit that still lands when a player blocks it, 0 to 1. Default 0.2 (blocking is 80% effective against NPCs); 0 restores full blocks. A player's hit on a blocking player stays fully blocked, NPCs blocking are unchanged. Under the rebalance formula the same share of the NPC's damage after DT lands. Read by the native server at boot.

combatCritNotice.label: Critical hit notices
combatCritNotice.help: On (default, also when unset): while alduinakDamageFormulaSettings.enabled is true a critical hit tells the attacking player "Critical hit! <damage> damage." and the player hit "You took a critical hit: <damage> damage.". Off keeps both off. Read by the gamemode when it loads: Build gamemode only or a restart applies a change.

craftedExtrasTemperRules.label: Temper rules in vanilla menus
craftedExtrasTemperRules.help: On: a temper done in the vanilla menu follows the recipe's rank gates and rank cap and costs one craft of fatigue. Off: it takes the materials only, up to Legendary, as in 1.0. Unset (default): on while alduinakDamageFormulaSettings has enabled or durability.enabled true, off otherwise. Read at boot.

chatRanges.label: Chat ranges
chatRanges.help: Audible ranges in game units: { whisper, low, say, wide, shout }. Provided keys override the defaults.

voiceChat.label: Voice chat
voiceChat.help: LiveKit proximity voice: { enabled, url, apiKey, apiSecret, room, rangeUnits }. rangeUnits = MAX talk range (defaults to chatRanges.shout); speakers pick their range between chatRanges.whisper and this with V + mousewheel.

maskName.label: Mask name
maskName.help: Name shown for a /mask-ed player. Default "Masked Person".

introduceCooldownMs.label: Introduce cooldown (ms)
introduceCooldownMs.help: Min gap between /introduce prompts to the same target. Default 10000.

masteryKitGold.label: Profession kit gold
masteryKitGold.help: Gold every profession's starting kit carries on top of its items, alchemists included; a character that got gold from Starting items gets none. Default 50; 0 turns it off. Read at boot.

gatheringVeinTotal.label: Ore per vein
gatheringVeinTotal.help: Ore collections every mining vein holds, one per pickaxe strike. Default 6; 0 uses each record's own total (3 for vanilla veins). Read at boot.

gatheringVeinRespawnMinutes.label: Vein regrow (minutes)
gatheringVeinRespawnMinutes.help: Minutes after the first ore taken until the whole vein is back at once. Default 1440 (24 h); 0 keeps the default. Read at boot.

gatheringVeinRegenMinutes.label: Vein gradual regrow (minutes)
gatheringVeinRegenMinutes.help: Leave empty (default) for the whole vein at once. Set: one ore collection grows back per that many minutes instead. Read at boot.

gatheringProduceYield.label: Beehive yield
gatheringProduceYield.help: { "<container editor id>": { "<item editor id>": count } } handed over on E instead of the container record's contents. Default: occupied and vacant beehives and apiaries give 2 Bee Honeycomb, 2 Bee and 2 Beehive Husk, back after an hour (gatheringProduceContainers). Read at boot.

gatheringPickMinutes.label: Nirnroot and critter regrow (minutes)
gatheringPickMinutes.help: Minutes a picked nirnroot or a caught bee or firefly stays gone for everyone. Default 30. Read at boot.

huntingSkinPlayers.label: Hunters skin player bodies
huntingSkinPlayers.help: A hunter with the hunting knife skins a dead player's body during the respawn wait, or the body a PK left, for Human Flesh, maybe a Human Heart and on a Khajiit maybe a Khajiit Pelt; an own body then vanishes as if looted (the player respawns at once with their pack), a PK body also gives the skinner everything it holds, keys and letters included. crouch (default, also when unset): the body opens a Search and Skin menu for them (a client without the menu skins on crouch and interact), anyone else searches. interact: every interact skins, as on an animal. off: never. Read at boot.

huntingHumanHeartChance.label: Human heart chance
huntingHumanHeartChance.help: Chance, 0 to 1, that skinning a player's body also gives a Human Heart. Default 0.1. Read at boot.

huntingKhajiitPeltChance.label: Khajiit pelt chance
huntingKhajiitPeltChance.help: Chance, 0 to 1, that skinning a player's body that looks Khajiit (KhajiitRace or its vampire form, a PK body included) also gives a Khajiit Pelt (AldKhajiitPelt, plugin r24). Default 0.2. Read at boot.

gatheringAlchemistFloraDiscount.label: Alchemist flora discount
gatheringAlchemistFloraDiscount.help: Extra share of the fatigue an alchemist (Novice or better) saves when picking alchemy flora (flowers, mushrooms, herbs and nirnroot that give an ingredient, never crops), on top of the farmer price for their rank they already pay. Default 0 (off); 0.5 halves it again. Read at boot.

needsSurvivalModeFlag.label: Survival mode flag on clients
needsSurvivalModeFlag.help: On (default): clients set the Creation's Survival_ModeToggle (SRVT) to 1 with each needs update. The HUD polls that global every frame and draws the red penalty segments on the stamina and magicka bars only under it; off, the HUD clears them once after each load whatever the penalty globals hold. Survival_ModeEnabled is script-only, nothing in the engine reads it. On also gives every client the engine's Survival extras: arrows, bolts and the lockpick weigh their record weight and armour cards show a Warmth line. Read at boot.

racialPassives.label: Racial passives
racialPassives.help: The only place race numbers live; resistances, stats, claws and powers stay in the plugin. { enabled (default true; false makes every race neutral), aliases { "<race>": "<entry race>" } over the built-in vampire and child races, races { "<RaceEditorId>": { fatigueCostMult, hungerRateMult, coldRateMult, warmth, rawMeatSafe, freezingWaterImmune, startingItems [{ baseId, count }] } }, startItemsSince (epoch ms or a date, default the 1.0 launch: a character created since then gets missed start items at its next login), selfCheck ("off" default, "log" logs each client race report as check ok or MISMATCH, "resync" also asks the client once per spawn to redo its race sync), powers { "<SPEL editor id>": { cooldownHours (real hours from the last use, counting offline, default 0), consumeOnMiss (default false), commandAnimal { ... } } }: a player's cast of a listed power is refused while its cooldown runs, and a power whose effect block is not built yet (Command Animal until RC6) is always refused }. A missing multiplier is 1, warmth 0, a flag false; empty makes every race neutral. The Test Nord entry is { "warmth": 25, "freezingWaterImmune": false }: Nords grow cold like anyone and carry Survival's 25 warmth. Start items come once per profile and slot when creation finishes and never count as starter gold. Not protected: Migrate settings carries it to live, so remove quick-test powers first. Read at boot; see docs_racial_passives.md.

survivalEnabled.label: Survival enabled
survivalEnabled.help: Master switch for cold, afflictions, raw meat, diseases and the body rules. Default off. Off, or a part switched off, undoes at each login what an earlier session granted. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live; set it there by hand once survival is signed off.

survivalRespawnHealthPoints.label: Respawn health points
survivalRespawnHealthPoints.help: Health points a respawn after a death (temple, afterlife arrival) and a staff revive wake with, measured against the race base health (100, an Orc 150); magicka and stamina keep theirs. Default 1; 0 uses the share below.

survivalRespawnHealth.label: Respawn health share
survivalRespawnHealth.help: Share of base health a respawn wakes with when the points above are 0, above 0 up to 1. Default 0.01; 1 turns the respawn rule off, whatever the points say.

survivalCarryWeightSpell.label: Carry weight ability
survivalCarryWeightSpell.help: Editor id or "hex:Plugin" desc of a carry weight ability every character is granted, in quotes. Default "" (none, carry weight stays 300, and a character holding one loses it at login); "Survival_abLowerCarryWeightSpell" is Survival's carry weight 150.

survivalNoHealthRegen.label: Slow health regeneration
survivalNoHealthRegen.help: On (default): every character holds AldSurvival_AbNoHealthRegen (plugin r27a). Since plugin r29 the ability slows health regeneration to a full bar in about 30 minutes; up to r28 it stopped it. Potions, food and Restoration still heal. Off removes it at login. The server half is Health regen multiplier (Gameplay), which should be 0.08 to match; 0 refuses all regeneration.

survivalFreezingWater.label: Freezing water
survivalFreezingWater.help: On (default): swimming in a freezing area raises cold to 300 at once, holds cold level 30 and takes health (next key). Off removes all of it.

survivalFreezingWaterDamage.label: Freezing water health / s
survivalFreezingWaterDamage.help: Health points a real second of swimming in freezing water takes, before frost resistance. Default 0.25: a full bar of 100 lasts 6 min 40 s (Survival's own 5 a second took 20 s). 0 takes no health.

survivalFoodPoisoningChance.label: Raw meat poisoning chance
survivalFoodPoisoningChance.help: Chance raw meat gives food poisoning, times (1 - disease resistance); 0 to 1, 0 turns it off. Races with racialPassives rawMeatSafe never get it.

survivalFoodPoisoningHours.label: Food poisoning hours
survivalFoodPoisoningHours.help: Real hours food poisoning lasts, offline included.

survivalRawMeatExtra.label: Extra raw meat
survivalRawMeatExtra.help: More raw meat foods: editor ids, hex ids or descs, on top of Survival_FoodRawMeat and the hunting meats. Default [].

survivalCure.label: What cures
survivalCure.help: cureDiseaseOrHealth (default): a Cure Disease potion or a potion restoring the minimum health below cures diseases, food poisoning and afflictions. cureDisease: Cure Disease potions only. Shrines never cure.

survivalCureMinHealth.label: Curing potion health
survivalCureMinHealth.help: Health a potion must restore to cure under cureDiseaseOrHealth.

survivalColdEnabled.label: Cold enabled
survivalColdEnabled.help: On (default): cold and warmth run while survival is on. Off takes the cold stage ability back at login.

survivalColdHoursToNumb.label: Hours to Numb
survivalColdHoursToNumb.help: Real hours in which cold level 20 with no warmth fills the bar at an area rate of 1, 20 times slower than single player. 0.02 only for quick tests, never on live.

survivalColdLevelMult.label: Cold level multiplier
survivalColdLevelMult.help: Survival_ColdLevelMult: with no warmth, cold rises this much per cold level in survivalColdHoursToNumb hours (50 x level 20 = 1000).

survivalColdStages.label: Cold stages
survivalColdStages.help: Cold at which Comfortable, Chilly, Very Cold, Freezing and Numb begin: five rising numbers below 1000. Default [50, 120, 300, 500, 800].

survivalColdStart.label: Starting cold
survivalColdStart.help: Cold of a new character, after a respawn and after an admin reset; offline warming stops here.

survivalColdLevels.label: Cold levels
survivalColdLevels.help: { warm, cool, freezing, chillyInterior, warmNight, coolNight, freezingNight, rain, snow, blizzard, freezingWater } merged over the default { 0, 3, 6, 6, 1, 2, 4, 3, 6, 10, 30 }.

survivalColdAreaRate.label: Cold area rates
survivalColdAreaRate.help: { warm, cool, freezing, chillyInterior } merged over the default { 1, 1, 0.6667, 0.6667 }: cold gain multiplier of the area class the character stands in, not applied in freezing water. The default makes a freezing blizzard night with no warmth take one hour from no cold to Freezing; 0.8333 for freezing and chillyInterior puts the hour on a snowy night (a blizzard night 48 minutes); 1 everywhere is Survival's plain pace (40 minutes).

survivalColdLevelCaps.label: Cold level caps
survivalColdLevelCaps.help: Cold level that lets cold reach stages 1 to 5: five rising numbers. Default [1, 4, 7, 10, 13].

survivalNightHours.label: Night hours
survivalNightHours.help: [after, before] on the game clock. Default [19, 7].

survivalRegionClimate.label: Region climate
survivalRegionClimate.help: { "<weather region id>": "warm" | "cool" | "freezing" | "none" } merged over the 45 classed regions of survivalClimate.ts.

survivalWorldClimate.label: World climate
survivalWorldClimate.help: { "<worldspace editor id>": class } merged over the defaults (Whiterun, Windhelm, Solitude and Markarth worlds cool, Riften warm, the realms none).

survivalHighAltitude.label: High altitude
survivalHighAltitude.help: { freezingZ, "<weather region id>": height }: freezing above the height. Default { "freezingZ": 19000, "fallForest": 15150 }.

survivalColdWarmPerMinute.label: Warming per minute
survivalColdWarmPerMinute.help: Cold lost per minute above the cold level's cap, not within 10 s of a hit.

survivalColdOfflineWarmPerHour.label: Offline warming per hour
survivalColdOfflineWarmPerHour.help: Cold lost per hour logged out, down to the starting cold.

survivalHeatRadius.label: Heat radius
survivalHeatRadius.help: Units from a fire, forge or cooking pot within which a character standing still warms.

survivalHeatRestore.label: Heat warming
survivalHeatRestore.help: Cold taken off by a heat source every check.

survivalHeatCheckSeconds.label: Heat check (s)
survivalHeatCheckSeconds.help: Seconds between heat checks, 1 or more.

survivalHeatStillUnits.label: Heat stand-still distance
survivalHeatStillUnits.help: A character who moved less than this since the last check counts as standing still.

survivalHeatExtraBases.label: Extra heat sources
survivalHeatExtraBases.help: Base editor ids or descs that also warm. Read by misc/gen-heat-sources.py, which writes heatSources.ts: rerun it and Build server after a change. Default [].

survivalHeatKeywords.label: Heat furniture keywords
survivalHeatKeywords.help: Furniture keywords that warm, read by misc/gen-heat-sources.py like the key above. Default ["CraftingCookpot", "AldCraftingKiln"].

survivalWarmth.label: Warmth ratings
survivalWarmth.help: { normal, warm, cold: [body, head, hands, feet], torch, cloak, max, maxReduction } merged over { [27, 18, 13, 13], [54, 29, 24, 24], [17, 8, 7, 7], 50, 0, 206, 0.85 }: max warmth cuts cold gain by maxReduction.

survivalWarmthTable.label: Warmth table
survivalWarmthTable.help: On (default): the server rates the pieces the engine's Survival keywords leave out from armorWarmth.ts (misc/gen-armor-warmth.py): mod pieces and enchanted copies count as warm or cold like the comparable base game piece, and cloaks, capes, collars, scarves and masks add 3 to 20 warmth. Off counts keywords only, as the item cards show.

survivalHotFoodWarmthMinutes.label: Hot food minutes
survivalHotFoodWarmthMinutes.help: Real minutes a hot meal keeps warming.

survivalSpellHitCold.label: Spell hit cold
survivalSpellHitCold.help: Cold a frost spell hit adds (up to Freezing) and a fire spell hit takes off (down to Chilly).

survivalColdOnHit.label: Cold from creature hits
survivalColdOnHit.help: { "<race editor id fragment>": cold } added by an unblocked hit of those races, merged over { "frostbitespider": 30, "falmer": 30 }.

survivalColdKills.label: Cold kills
survivalColdKills.help: On kills a character at cold 1000. Default off.

survivalColdStageAbilities.label: Cold stage abilities
survivalColdStageAbilities.help: On (default): the Survival_ColdStage0..5 ability of the current stage (speed, lockpicking, the frost shader).

survivalColdHealthPenalty.label: Cold health penalty
survivalColdHealthPenalty.help: On (default): clients shrink maximum health by the cold share, like hunger and fatigue do stamina and magicka.

survivalColdMaxHealthPenalty.label: Cold health penalty cap
survivalColdMaxHealthPenalty.help: Largest share of maximum health cold takes, 0 to 1, so Numb keeps a fifth of the bar.

survivalColdHealthScale.label: Cold health scale (native)
survivalColdHealthScale.help: Off (default): the cold penalty only shrinks the health bar on the client, the server counts damage and healing against the full base maximum. On: the server also writes private.healthScale (1 - the penalty) and the native counts damage, potions and food against the shrunk maximum, so a Numb character of base 100 has 20 health points. Untested in game.

survivalFreezingWaterWorlds.label: Freezing water worlds
survivalFreezingWaterWorlds.help: Worldspace editor ids whose water always freezes, besides freezing areas and cold interiors. Default ["DLC1HunterHQWorld"].

survivalAfflictions.label: Afflictions
survivalAfflictions.help: { weakened, frostbitten: { chance 0 to 1, tickMinutes } | false } merged over { 0.2, 15 }, { 0.16, 5 }, rolled at Starving and Numb; false turns them all off.

survivalAfflictionHours.label: Affliction hours
survivalAfflictionHours.help: Real hours an affliction lasts, offline included (0.1 only for quick tests).

survivalDiseasesEnabled.label: Diseases enabled
survivalDiseasesEnabled.help: On (default): creature hits and contagion give diseases while survival is on. Off gives none and removes those held at login.

survivalDiseases.label: Disease overrides
survivalDiseases.help: { "<disease id>": false | { name, contagious, stageHours [h1, h2] } } over the 27 catalog diseases of survivalDiseases.ts; false drops one. Default {}.

survivalDiseaseCarriers.label: Disease carriers
survivalDiseaseCarriers.help: { "<race editor id fragment>": false | { chance 0 to 1, diseases [ids] } } merged over the 20 default carriers (skeever, wolf, bear, troll, draugr, ...).

survivalDiseaseCarrierExclude.label: Races that carry nothing
survivalDiseaseCarrierExclude.help: Race editor id fragments no carrier matches. Default ["werewolf", "werebear"].

survivalDiseaseStageHours.label: Disease stage hours
survivalDiseaseStageHours.help: [stage 1 to 2, stage 2 to 3] in real hours, offline included; stage 3 stays until cured. Default [84, 84] ([0.05, 0.05] only for quick tests).

survivalMaxDiseases.label: Most diseases at once
survivalMaxDiseases.help: Diseases a character can hold at once; an admin may give more.

survivalContagionChance.label: Contagion chance
survivalContagionChance.help: Chance per contagious disease a client reports near the player, times (1 - disease resistance); the server rolls once per confirmed disease and pair per cooldown; 0 turns contagion off.

survivalContagionRange.label: Contagion range
survivalContagionRange.help: Units within which the client counts a carrier; empty uses the chat whisper range (chatRanges.whisper).

survivalContagionCheckSeconds.label: Contagion check (s)
survivalContagionCheckSeconds.help: Seconds between one client's contagion checks, 1 or more; the server accepts one report per player per this less 5 s.

survivalContagionCooldownMinutes.label: Contagion cooldown (min)
survivalContagionCooldownMinutes.help: Minutes before the same disease and pair of players roll again; 0 rolls at every report.

captureInteractMaxDistance.label: Capture range
captureInteractMaxDistance.help: Max game-units distance to start a capture/carry. Default 256.

captureConsentTimeoutMs.label: Capture consent timeout (ms)
captureConsentTimeoutMs.help: How long a capture/carry consent prompt waits for an answer. Default 20000.

captureConsentCooldownMs.label: Capture consent cooldown (ms)
captureConsentCooldownMs.help: Min gap before prompting the same target again. Default 15000.

tradeMaxDistance.label: Trade range
tradeMaxDistance.help: Max game-units distance both players must stay within to trade. Default 1024.

tradeInviteTtlMs.label: Trade invite TTL (ms)
tradeInviteTtlMs.help: Pending trade invites auto-cancel after this. Default 60000.

tradeInviteCooldownMs.label: Trade invite cooldown (ms)
tradeInviteCooldownMs.help: Min gap between trade invites per initiator to target. Default 30000.

searchStartMaxDistance.label: Search start range
searchStartMaxDistance.help: Max game-units distance to start searching a player. Default 256.

searchKeepMaxDistance.label: Search keep range
searchKeepMaxDistance.help: The search window closes once the pair drift further apart than this. Default 512.

searchConsentTimeoutMs.label: Search consent timeout (ms)
searchConsentTimeoutMs.help: How long a search consent prompt waits for an answer. Default 20000.

searchConsentCooldownMs.label: Search consent cooldown (ms)
searchConsentCooldownMs.help: Min gap before prompting the same target again. Default 15000.

keySplitOnLogin.label: Split old key stacks at login
keySplitOnLogin.help: Splits a stack of property keys cut before keys were numbered (Property Key (TAG) xN) into N numbered keys when its holder logs in. Keep off until the client with the new SkyrimPlatformImpl.dll has shipped and named keys stay separate in game; an older client merges the split keys back and put/take fails. Read at startup. Default off.

bountyBoardCostGold.label: Bounty board post cost
bountyBoardCostGold.help: Gold taken for pinning a notice on a Missives board. 0 = free. Default 25.

bountyBoardStashBase.label: Bounty board strongbox base
bountyBoardStashBase.help: CONT base (hex:Plugin desc or load-order id) placed at each board to hold the posting fees. A strongbox of another base is replaced at the next start, contents moved over. Default the vanilla strongbox without items (StrongBox); pick a base with no items of its own, or every client shows its own rolled loot in it. Read at startup.

bountyBoardStashLift.label: Bounty board strongbox lift
bountyBoardStashLift.help: { "<board name>": units } the strongbox stands above the visible board's foot, over the built-in lifts (Winterhold 40, Dawnstar 49, Falkreath 17; misc/bounty-stash-lift.py measures them). A box off its spot is moved at the next start, contents kept. Read at startup.

writingEnabled.label: Writeable letters and books
writingEnabled.help: Lets players write letters, journals and books. Keep off until the plugin with the writing records is in the manifest and players have re-downloaded. Read at startup. Default off.

gamemodeHotReload.label: Gamemode hot reload
gamemodeHotReload.help: On: the server reloads gamemode.js about a second after it changes (Build gamemode only). Off (default, also when unset): gamemode.js loads only when the server starts. On for the Test Server, off on live. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

databaseName.label: Database name
databaseName.help: File DB folder / Mongo db name. Characters live in <name>/changeForms.

databaseUri.label: Database URI
databaseUri.help: Mongo connection string (mongodb driver only). Embeds credentials - keep it secret.

logDir.label: Log directory
logDir.help: Where chat.log and service logs are written. Overridden by the ALDUINAK_LOG_DIR env var.

loadOrder.label: Load order
loadOrder.help: Array of ESM/ESP filenames in order.

archives.label: BSA archives
archives.help: Array of BSA filenames to load.

reloot.label: Reloot timers
reloot.help: Record type → ms before respawn. FLOR and TREE are the alchemy plants: 1800000 (30 min) live, one hour when unset. Native server, read at boot.

forbiddenReloot.label: Forbidden reloot
forbiddenReloot.help: Record types that never respawn; wins over Reloot timers. Item types (MISC, WEAP, ...) and FLOR/TREE: a plugin-placed ref is taken once and never comes back. "LIGH": placed torches and lanterns. "CONT": an emptied container never refills, so storage chests stay player-only. Native server, read at boot.

emptyContainers.label: Empty containers
emptyContainers.help: On (default, also when unset): chests, barrels and other placed containers from every plugin open without their plugin loot; items players put in stay, and containers already filled keep what they hold. Off: a container that never received anything gets its plugin loot on its next open. NPCs and corpses are unaffected. Native server, read at boot.

containerLootBaseIds.label: Containers keeping loot
containerLootBaseIds.help: CONT base records (numbers, "0x..." strings or "hex:File.esp") that keep their plugin loot while Empty containers is on. Default []. Native server, read at boot.

exteriorScriptAllowlist.label: Exterior scripts
exteriorScriptAllowlist.help: Vanilla Papyrus scripts that still run on exterior objects; every other vanilla script is stripped there. Default: ["default2StateActivator", "NorLever01SCRIPT"] so lever-driven exterior gates open. [] strips them too. Native server, read at boot.

leverLinks.label: Lever links
leverLinks.help: Levers wired to their gate through markers the server never loads: [{ levers:["hex:File.esp", ...], target:"hex:File.esp", all?, openAnim?, closeAnim? }]. all: every lever pulled once before the target moves. A DOOR target toggles isOpen, anything else plays open/close. Default: Soljund's Sinkhole portcullis. [] disables. Read at boot.

blockedSpells.label: Blocked spells
blockedSpells.help: Spell form ids players may not cast (numbers or "0x..." strings), e.g. racial powers.

adminProfileIds.label: Admin profile IDs
adminProfileIds.help: Master-api profile ids granted in-game admin chat commands. Array of numbers.

adminRoleIds.label: Admin Discord roles
adminRoleIds.help: Legacy flat list of Discord role ids (strings) that get the in-game admin menu (Insert) and the server console. Roles here but in no adminRoles tier get full (senior) rights. Example: ["1521259484859863190"].

adminRoles.label: Admin role tiers
adminRoles.help: Discord role ids per tier: { senior:[...], developer:[...], gm:[...] }. senior and gm have every power; developer has everything except Kick and Ban. Tier lists win over adminRoleIds; precedence senior > developer > gm.

adminTeleportLocations.label: Admin teleport locations
adminTeleportLocations.help: Admin panel Teleport tab: [{ name, cellOrWorldDesc: "hexId:Plugin.esm", pos:[x,y,z], rot:[x,y,z], kind? }]. Listed before the built-in map-marker locations; bad entries are dropped at boot.

alduinakDamageFormulaSettings.label: Rebalance and durability
alduinakDamageFormulaSettings.help: The generated block of misc/combat-settings/generate.py (staged in alduinak-r13/live); change design.json and run the generator again rather than editing rows here, and after every plugin change. Empty (default) = combat as in 1.0. enabled (default false): the rebalance formula prices weapon hits by row damage against worn DT, with playerHitCap (45), the sneak, power and rate limit rules and blockStamina { perArmorWeight 0.006, weightCap 115 }. durability.enabled (default false), independent of enabled: worn weapons, armor and shields wear on hits (durability.wear, HP tables per row), show a name tag (durability.nameTag { showAtFull true, brokenLabel "Broken" }) and are repaired at the benches; the condition is for roleplay only and changes no hit (durability.effect is checked but not applied). durability.repair { unitsPerMissing { weapon 0.5, cuirass 0.5, other 1 }: share one set of temper materials restores; fallbackMaterial { kind: { row: form key } } for items without a temper recipe; requireProfessionRank (false); fatigue (0); anyBench (false: workbench armor and shields, grindstone weapons); menuOnActivate (true); chatCommand ("repair", "" for none); lowNoticeBelow (0.25) }. effectModifiers (default true): OneHandedMod, TwoHandedMod, MarksmanMod and BlockMod of abilities and diseases scale weapon damage and blocking while either switch is on, so a hungry player's block leaks. A wrong value rejects the whole block with error lines at boot and the server runs as without it. Protected: Migrate settings never carries it to live. With plugin r28, enabled false is not a return to 1.0 numbers. Read at boot; see docs_server_configuration_reference.md.

combatTrace.label: Combat trace (debug)
combatTrace.help: On: the rebalance formula logs one line per priced weapon hit and per resisted spell hit, and NeedsSystem one line per block priced by armor weight, at info level (the balance trace). Off (default, also when unset): those lines stay at debug. Turn it on for the Test Server only; live keeps it off. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

maxMovementSpeed.label: Max movement speed
maxMovementSpeed.help: Authority check: horizontal units per second a movement report of a player may cover since the last accepted one (at least 0.13 s counted, plus 256 units of slack). Going over it logs `MovementValidation - <actor> moved <n> units in <s> s, over the <bound> units maxMovementSpeed allows, logged only|refused`, at most once per player every 30 s. Default 2048. Read at boot.

enforceMovementSpeed.label: Enforce max movement speed
enforceMovementSpeed.help: Off (default, also when unset): going over Max movement speed is only logged. On: the report is refused and the player is put back (Teleport2). Turn it on for the Test Server once the logs show no false positives (horses, Whirlwind Sprint, lag). Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

maxActivateDistance.label: Max activate distance
maxActivateDistance.help: Authority check: units from the player or hosted NPC to the object it activates (doors, containers, items, seats); closing a container or leaving a seat is never checked, nor is another cell. Going over it logs `ActionListener::OnActivate - <caster> activates <target> from <n> units, farther than maxActivateDistance <max>, logged only|refused`, at most once per player every 30 s. Default 1024. Read at boot.

enforceActivateDistance.label: Enforce max activate distance
enforceActivateDistance.help: Off (default, also when unset): an activation farther than Max activate distance is only logged. On: it is refused. Very large objects (gates) have far origins, so check the logs on the Test Server first. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

meleeSlack.label: Melee reach slack
meleeSlack.help: Authority check: units a melee hit of a player (fists, any weapon but a staff, a bow bash) may land beyond its reach, the weapon reach x fCombatDistance or the race unarmed reach, measured between the two origins. It covers body size and movement lag. NPC attackers are never checked, because creatures hit from far-off origins. Going over it logs `ActionListener::OnHit - <attacker> hits <target> with <weapon> from <n> units, beyond its reach <r> plus meleeSlack <slack>, logged only|refused`, at most once per player every 30 s. Default 400. Read at boot.

enforceMeleeReach.label: Enforce melee reach
enforceMeleeReach.help: Off (default, also when unset): a melee hit of a player beyond its reach plus Melee reach slack is only logged. On: the hit is refused. Large targets (dragons, mammoths, giants) have far origins, so check the logs on the Test Server first. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

maxShotDistance.label: Max shot distance
maxShotDistance.help: Authority check: units from the shooter, a player or a hosted NPC, to the target of a bow or crossbow hit. Going over it logs `ActionListener::OnHit - <shooter> shoots <target> with <weapon> from <n> units, farther than maxShotDistance <max>, logged only|refused`, at most once per player every 30 s. Default 8192. Read at boot.

enforceShotDistance.label: Enforce max shot distance
enforceShotDistance.help: Off (default, also when unset): a shot farther than Max shot distance is only logged. On: the hit is refused. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

spellHitWindow.label: Spell hit window
spellHitWindow.help: Authority check: seconds a spell hit may land after the longest effect duration of the last cast or keep-alive of that spell by the attacker, or of a cloak or hazard spell that grants it. Players and hosted NPCs are checked. Going over it logs `ActionListener::OnHit - <attacker> hits <target> with spell <spell> without a cast of it or of a spell that grants it within its longest effect plus spellHitWindow <s> s, logged only|refused`, at most once per player every 30 s. Separately, a second hit by the same attacker on the same target with the same spell within 90 ms is always dropped. Default 10. Read at boot.

enforceSpellHitWindow.label: Enforce spell hit window
enforceSpellHitWindow.help: Off (default, also when unset): a spell hit outside Spell hit window is only logged. On: the hit is refused. Runes triggered long after their cast and creature breath or spit attacks that send no cast can fall outside it, so check the logs on the Test Server first. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

maxAppearanceNameLength.label: Max appearance name length
maxAppearanceNameLength.help: Authority check: characters of the name in an appearance, from the race menu or a server write (character creation, /mask, polymorph). Going over it, like a head part that is not an HDPT, a face texture that is not a TXST or a weight outside 0-100, logs `MpActor::SetAppearanceAndBroadcast - appearance of <actor>: <problems>, logged only|refused`. A race that is not a RACE is always refused. Default 64. Read at boot.

maxAppearanceTints.label: Max appearance tints
maxAppearanceTints.help: Authority check: tint layers in an appearance, logged like Max appearance name length. Default 128. Read at boot.

enforceAppearanceLimits.label: Enforce appearance limits
enforceAppearanceLimits.help: Off (default, also when unset): an appearance over Max appearance name length or Max appearance tints, or with a head part, face texture or weight the plugins do not back, is only logged. On: it is refused and the old look stays. Head parts from a client-side cosmetic plugin that the server does not load would be refused, so check the logs on the Test Server first. Protected: Migrate settings never copies it to live. Read at boot.

discordAuth.label: Discord auth
discordAuth.help: Discord bot integration: { botToken, guilds:[{ guildId, banRoleId, eventLogChannelId }] }. Holds a bot token - keep it secret.

discordAlertKinds.label: Discord alert kinds
discordAlertKinds.help: Alert kinds posted to the event log channel. Default ["admin","execute","ticket"]; add "keyword" or "login" to post them. Deaths are never posted. Read at boot.

RELAY_SECRET.label: Relay secret
RELAY_SECRET.help: Shared between the relay, the gamemode, and this manager.

SERVER_ADDRESS.label: Public address
SERVER_ADDRESS.help: Public IP advertised to external clients.

LAUNCH_CHECK_ENFORCE.label: Enforce launch check
LAUNCH_CHECK_ENFORCE.help: Refuse connections whose launcher did not verify client files + load order. Unset = enforced (the default); only Off disables it, for players on pre-check launcher builds.

BAN_LOG_DIR.label: Ban log directory
BAN_LOG_DIR.help: Where ban.log and faction.log are written. Empty = the default logs folder.

CLIENT_FILES_DIR.label: Client files directory
CLIENT_FILES_DIR.help: Folder holding the served client files. Empty = build/client-files.

ALDUINAK_GH_TOKEN.label: GitHub token (PAT)
ALDUINAK_GH_TOKEN.help: PAT with actions:write - powers the manager CI Rebuild (workflow dispatch).

MANAGER_AGENT_PORT.label: Agent port
MANAGER_AGENT_PORT.help: Loopback port of the AlduinakManager service. Default 4003. Restart the backend and the agent after a change.

MANAGER_AGENT_SECRET.label: Agent secret
MANAGER_AGENT_SECRET.help: Shared secret the backend signs agent calls with, at least 32 characters.

MANAGER_LOG_DIR.label: Manager log folder
MANAGER_LOG_DIR.help: Web jobs, their logs, the busy lock and the audit files.

MANAGER_AUDIT_WEBHOOK_URL.label: Audit Discord webhook
MANAGER_AUDIT_WEBHOOK_URL.help: Optional private staff channel webhook that mirrors manager actions and failed logins.
